command: cat src/inventory/pricing.py; echo '---TESTS---'; cat tests/test_pricing.py; echo '---CONFTEST---'; cat tests/conftest.py; echo '---PYPROJECT---'; cat pyproject.toml
for f in .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/policy.toml .gnomon/config.toml .gnomon/roles.toml .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md .gnomon/tools.toml; do echo "---$f---"; cat "$f"; done
cat README.md TODO.md CHANGELOG.md; git status --short; git log --oneline -5

tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opencode/coupon-old.XXXXXX); cp -r src tests pyproject.toml "$tmp"/; git show HEAD:src/inventory/pricing.py > "$tmp/src/inventory/pricing.py"; cd "$tmp" && python3 -m pytest -q; status=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $status
